Experience
Sep 2026 • Family
We visited 4P’s Pizza at D1Mension Residences, and the food was absolutely awesome and delicious. Unfortunately, there were a couple of things that took away from an otherwise enjoyable dining experience.

While serving the dishes, the staff held the food in their hands while explaining the dishes to us from very close range. Because they were speaking so close to the food, I was concerned about saliva droplets potentially reaching the dishes. I found this quite unpleasant and felt that it could be handled in a more hygienic way.

The toilet was another disappointment. It was quite smelly and did not appear to be very clean or well maintained, which was surprising given the restaurant's overall standard.

The food itself was excellent, but I hope the restaurant will pay more attention to food-handling and hygiene practices. These small details can make a big difference to the overall dining experience.

Food good, service not so much.
Apr 2026 • Solo
Pizza 4ps, why have I been having SO MUCH difficulty giving my money to
Pizza 4ps in just the past week? Please make this make sense. I walk there, quite a distance, about 15 minutes before closing. I am told NO, the kitchen closed at 10:30. Why is that not stated on your web page? If it was, I would have never walked there and would not have a problem with this. 

A few days later I walk to a different location, there are at least two empty tables AND at least four empty seats at the bar, I am told NO, they are reserved. I am there, the people who reserved are not. They don’t want my money, I did not reserve. I wasn’t planning to stay for hours, probably 35 minutes at most. Is the thinking that the people who reserve can not be made wait one minute? Seat me, I will be done shortly and the people who reserved will have a very short wait, if any. 

Tonight at Hanoi Centre I am told I can be seated in 75 minutes. I walk around the building and see 8-10 open tables inside and every one outside was unoccupied. I asked how many tables have to be open for me to get a seat at one? I was asked, do you want a table outside? Why wasn’t that offered when I first got there? A manager was called over and I explained the situation, she seated me immediately inside. How does this restaurant have staff whose reactions are completely opposite of each other in 5 minutes time? Make this make sense. I apologized to the manager for appearing frustrated, she found a simple solution to a problem that shouldn’t have existed. She apologized and offered me a complimentary dessert, when I declined and asked for the check she came back, giving me a 50% discount. I hope her bosses are reading this, she is the type of employee you need to keep, she deserves praise, even some extra financial compensation for doing such a great job. Your business will succeed with her problem solving skill and solutions. Please don’t misunderstand me, I have no pretense to think that I should be given special treatment of any kind but the reactions I got made no sense to me, until this manager did such a wonderful job, I thank her so very much and I will return because of her.

Someday when your business isn’t thriving as much as it is today, you should be happy to have customers like me to patronize your restaurant, even after this poor service.

From stars to stables in just three days
Aug 2025 • Family
Traveling to Vietnam with the family we stayed to have dinner twice at this restaurant. The first night we had a Perfect Processing and the food is really great (including pizza). Having been fine on the return of our tour in Cambodia we decided to return three days later, wanting once again to have an alternative to Vietnamese cuisine. The evening was a nightmare. I state I had booked. They made us sit at the same table as three days earlier, when a waitress showed up that we had not seen before. This started to draw up a waiting list 40 minutes 20 minutes on plate that we were ordering, with a lot of effort considering the bad English of the same we were able to tell her to bring the dishes that branch ready in reasonable terms so that the waiting minutes that the waitress had proposed would have passed in the meantime. Morale arrived all together and after about thirty minutes. Spaghetti pizza and meat that I would share with my son. Of course we ate cold pasta and cold meat. Solicited the waitress this was sent another girl who apologized for all the inconvenience they caused us. Not to mention the air conditioning that both scientists could not regulate. Actually they offered us a dessert to overcome their capacity but we refused because we wanted to leave. That said it's a real shame because in your restaurant you eat really well., but you have to invest in capable staff to avoid a horror night like ours,

Molto buono!
Aug 2025 • Family
We originally went to another 4P’s in HCM but they were fully booked up. The lady at reception was kind enough to find availability at this location so we hopped in a grab and headed over.

We weren’t sure what to expect being a half Italian family who go to Italy at least once a year, but having read the great reviews, were intrigued to what a Vietnamese Italian could offer.

We were pleasantly surprised - the quality of ingredients and execution of the dishes was excellent. We had pizza’s - margherita, spicy shrimp, and salami, and the crab spaghetti. All very good.

The food did take slightly too long to come out but our waitress dealt with it so well that it didn’t matter - you can tell they take service very seriously here. 

Highly recommended!
